dataList.content:
We came upon a monumental castle of ice, flanked by frozen pillars that seemed to boast an indestructible durability.
呈现在我们眼前的是一座巨大的冰之城堡，与看上去似乎坚不可摧的冰块。
dataList.place:
Ice Castle Where Neighbors Lie
沉眠着邻里的冰霜城堡

dataList.content:
Before it stood a person…
而就在那里，

A man with hyaline hair, clear as ice, waiting for us.
一个有着冰一样透明头发的人在等着我们。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
I'd come here whenever I felt the need to clear my thoughts. Though there are no armchairs or that whiskey you like…
我有时会在思绪混乱的时候来这里。哪怕没有你喜欢的安乐椅和威士忌……

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
... the chill dominating this place pierces even the thickest coat. That helps me think with a more lucid mind.
在这里，哪怕外套裹得再严实，寒冷也会渗入其中。因此思维会更为明晰。

While the rest of us were frozen stiff, stuck watching, Rodya made a slow step forward to face him.
我们像是被寒气冻住了一般凝视着他，而罗佳则慢慢走到了他的面前。

Didn’t expect you to get here first.
没想到你先到了。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
My men and I knew of a shortcut leading here.
我和队员们早就知道有捷径通往这里。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
It was a route we learned by parlaying with the local lowlives in our search for the whereabouts of a great, buried power waiting to be used for our noble purpose.
这是从这个地区的非常渠道得到的资料。关于那埋藏着可以实现我们伟大理想的强大力量的空间。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
Alas, we... could only make it as far as this place, the general vicinity of the buried Golden Bough; we could not get any closer to it.
但我们也只是……接近了这埋藏着金枝的空间，之后就不知道该怎么做了。

Thought you'd never leave District 25, but seeing you resorting to those tactics like some kind of gangster... Maybe you should've stayed a country boy.
我还以为你会一直窝在25区呢，不过比起干着这和犯罪团伙一样的勾当，你还不如一直窝着呢。

Sonya, your lackeys have been taking from shopkeeps who weren’t even rich to begin with.
索尼亚。拜你所赐，那些无辜商人们的钱也被抢走了。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
… Want to know something, Rodya? This cave used to be nothing more than a peculiar hollow whose walls were lined with hoarfrost.
……你知道吗，罗佳？这里本不过是个结了许多冰霜，有些奇特的地方而已。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
And look at it now. A giant castle, surrounded by thick columns of ice, has risen here.
但你看看这个。现在这里却被巨大的城堡和坚硬的冰霜所覆盖。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
This change happened the instant you walked in.
从你踏入这里那一刻开始。

… Sounds like you figured this would happen on my arrival. How’d you know?
……你这口气，简直就像知道我来了就会变化一样。你怎么知晓的？

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
I have many sources… But that’s not for you to know, Rodya.
信息的来源有很多……但你没必要知道，罗佳。

What makes you say that I caused this in the first place? I’m not some kinda witch of the Backstreets or anything.
可你为何能断言那是因为我呢？我可不是什么在后巷里到处闲逛的魔术师。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
I think the answer to that should become quite obvious once you observe those faces encased in ice.
这并不难。只要看看他们在冰中沉眠的面容就能明白。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
Take a peek. They’re the ones you loved yet secretly contemned, are they not?
看看吧。他们不正是你所爱着，但同时又在心中瞧不起的面容吗？

dataList.title:
District 25
25区
dataList.content:
That’s all it’s worth? You can't be serious…
这个就只值那一点点吗？不可能啊……

dataList.title:
District 25
25区
dataList.teller:

dataList.content:

怎么不可能？又旧，划痕又多，还没有光泽。

dataList.content:
To be frank, others wouldn’t pay more than 200,000 for this.
说实话，别的地方连20万眼都不会出。

dataList.content:
And the rest… All worthless garbage.
剩下的……全是些没用的垃圾。

dataList.title:

25区
dataList.teller:

缺德的税费掠夺者
dataList.content:
With that, your remaining unpaid tax is now down to 400,000 Ahn.
这样一来，该交的税金还剩40万眼。

Why do the poor only grow poorer the harder they work?
为什么穷人们越是工作就越贫困呢？

It’s ridiculous, isn’t it? As the pawnbroker's vault grew fuller with each passing day...
真是太可笑了。当铺老板的保险柜里的钱越积越多，

... our neighbors only grew more gaunt, forced to give up even their precious mementos and cherished memories to be weighed for pocket money upon her ruthless scale.
而我的邻居们就连回忆都被放在天平上，被当作零钱一样对待。

Sonya rallied people, delivering speeches using big words.
索尼亚总是用深奥的言语将人们聚集在一起。

They organized a group under the name of the "Yurodiviye."
他们建立了名为“圣愚”的帮派。

It went okay at first. Sonya's words managed to inspire even the thickest folks to help the impoverished of the Backstreets.
最开始并无问题。就连脑子空空的家伙也会被索尼亚的话启发，去帮助后巷里的穷人。

But I could see it on Sonya's face that he still wanted something more.
但是，索尼亚还是一副有何不足的表情。

Eventually, the Yurodiviye that was first established to actually go out and help the needy was warped into an organization full of passive pundits who only cared about sitting around and endlessly debating how the streets and the Nests were to be revolutionized. 结果，比起在外面帮助他人，圣愚变成了热衷于在桌上烦恼该如何改变后巷和巢的团体。

That’s why I left them.
所以我决定离开他们。

Being an armchair revolutionary wasn’t going to feed our starving neighbors!
因为纸上谈兵无法喂饱饿肚子的邻居们！

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
But I told you time and time again, Rodya. That we must wait for the right moment.
但我已经说过很多次了吧，罗佳。我们应该等待时机。

Sonya, I’m sorry, but that “moment” you kept talking about…
索尼亚，不好意思，但那个“时机”……

It didn't come when little Ivan, Yurodiviye's youngest... dug through trash for food waste just to recall what having food in his stomach felt like...
在圣愚里最小的孩子……小伊凡因为捡食物垃圾吃，

Nor did it arrive after he choked to death from it.
气管堵塞而死之后，也没有到来。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
Detailed policy plans and the power to realize them are both necessary in monumental endeavors such as ours—the redistribution of wealth.
要想做成大事，就需要更强的力量和更详细的政策。这些都是为了财富的再分配。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
Such personal grievances and tragedies will inevitably occur as the wheel of progress turns.
此外，在朝那个方向前进之时，个人层面的杂音也会出现。
Personal? Don't you remember how it all began? Helping people was our purpose! 个人层面？我们本来就是为了帮助每一个人才开始的吧。

You and your Yurodiviye no longer seemed interested in doing that, nor in anything I'd hoped for when we began.
你所做的、圣愚所做的，和我期望的方向不符。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
Is that why you decided to take matters into your own hands?
所以你才决定自己动手吗？

Absolutely. What our town needed…
当然。我们的镇子所需要的……

... wasn’t an empty promise telling people to sit on their hands and wait for some vague "moment,"
不是去放手等待那个不知道何时才能到来的时机，

but someone willing to pick up the axe.
而是能毫不犹豫地抓起眼前的斧头的人。

It must've been one of those days when most of the neighborhood hadn't seen even a glimpse of food for at least 4 days.
那天，大多数邻居都应该饿了四天多了。

But the biting wind hounded and howled without mercy, clawing at the cracked skin of people who barely had any energy left to even move.
即便如此，风还是毫不留情地呼啸着，毫不留情地抓挠着饥饿的人们那开裂的皮肤。

And I happened to know whose safe kept so much money that she could treat my neighbors to a three-day-feast and not even make a dent.
而我知道一个存了一大笔钱的保险箱，就算请邻居们吃上三天三夜，也不会看出里面的钱少了多少。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
So, what did you do?
那，你做了什么？

… No, wait. I don't think I want to do this anymore.
……等等。我不能到此打住吗？

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
The Golden Bough has resonated with your psyche and has created this confessional of sorts, just for you.
这里是在金枝的共鸣之下，为你而生的某种告解室。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
And a confessional’s purpose is to lead a sinner to the path of penance.
而告解室主要是为了罪人的忏悔而存在。

dataList.title:
District 25
25区
dataList.teller:
Wicked Tax Collector
缺德的税费掠夺者

dataList.content:
If only that old woman had changed her mind in her last moments…
要是那个老太婆最后能洗心革面的话……

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
But Rodya…
但是罗佳……

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
You must have known that a terminal leech upon her neighbors wouldn't turn over a new leaf just like that.
一个一辈子都在想着掠夺邻居的老太婆，

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
You knew she wasn’t the kind of person who’d give up that life for that of a generous philanthropist.
并不会突然成为包容一切，拿出自己的钱的好人，这点你应该明白吧。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
You wouldn’t have brought the axe otherwise.
要是你知道的话，也不会一开始就拿起斧头上前去吧。

dataList.title:
District 25
25区
dataList.teller:
Wicked Tax Collector
缺德的税费掠夺者
dataList.content:
Poor Rodion, dear, you seem to be under the delusion that you’re some sort of savior…
可怜的罗季昂，你或许误以为自己能够成为伟大的救世主……

dataList.title:
District 25
25区
dataList.teller:
Wicked Tax Collector
缺德的税费掠夺者
dataList.content:
Demanding my money so brazenly to my face won’t change anything.
但就算你理直气壮地来要我的钱，也不会改变什么的。

dataList.title:
District 25
25区
dataList.teller:
Wicked Tax Collector
缺德的税费掠夺者
dataList.content:
You're nothing but a louse yourself, no different from the paupers in the Backstreets.
你也和那些后巷里的乞丐没什么两样，不过是些虫子而已。

That’s right.
对。

I’m the one who put an axe through her head.
劈开她脑袋的是我。

Like cutting open the belly of the goose that laid golden eggs, I cleaved into that hag’s skull.
就像剖开金鹅的肚子一样，我把老太婆的头盖骨漂亮地劈开了。

I mean, someone had to do it. Am I wrong?
毕竟总得有人去做。不是吗？

Unlike the idiot cottager in the fable who gave in to greed and severed his own future prospects…
金鹅不过是一个愚者因为欲望而断送机会的寓言故事，

... we were just hungry, miserable people who would've gladly scooped out her brains for a meal.
而我们这群不幸之人，饿到连吃光她的大脑都无法解恨。
And unlike the goose, her “belly” was full of golden eggs. 何况在那肚子里，确实塞满了金蛋。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
Yes, the old lady you killed was a tax collector wielding considerable authority in District 25.
对，那老太婆是在25区拥有很大权力的收税人。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
But what gave her so much power… was her sibling’s status as a member of The Middle.
但她之所以能那么大摇大摆地走下去……是因为她的弟弟是“中指”的成员。

I… I put an axe through her skull for my neighbors, so that they wouldn't starve to death. Was that so wrong?
我……为了即将饿死的邻居们而挥下了斧头。这有错吗？

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
No, you did that for yourself.
不，你是为了自己而挥下的。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
You couldn’t stand the fact that you weren’t anyone special.
你只是无法忍受自己不过是个平凡之人的事实。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
Did you know? The Middle… never forgets, never forgives anyone who has wronged their family.
你知道吗？中指……绝不会忘记对自己的家人出手的家伙们。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content: They aren’t too interested in finding out exactly who did the deed; what matters to them is that they demonstrate clearly what happens to the poor fools that dare to disturb them. 他们觉得“谁”做的不重要，反而对自己人动手的话“会怎样”更为重要。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
The joy of the Backstreets residents, who'd tasted the tenderness of quality meat for the first time in their lives, soon made corpse towers of them all.
第一次咀嚼着高级肉排的、喜悦的后巷居民，就这样变成了尸体，像塔一样堆积起来。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
Not much different from the car pagodas outside the casino.
就像赌场外面堆起的那座车塔一样。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
I’m well aware of the sheer weight of pain and guilt you’ve been burdened with ever since then.
我知道你自那天起，度过了多么痛苦，而又被罪恶感折磨的日子。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
It can't have been easy to live with the realization that, at the end of the day, you really weren't so different from the idiot who cut open the goose that laid golden eggs.
意识到自己其实和那个剖开金鹅的愚蠢农夫没什么区别，呢。

Since that day… Nothing I held truly felt like it was mine.
自那天起……无论是什么东西，我都感觉不到它完全属于自己了。

It's all... all my fa—
全都是我的错……

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
It's okay, Rodya.
都没关系的，罗佳。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
You see, Rodya...
我啊，罗佳。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
... I've perused hundreds of books and thousands of documents...
为了改变世界，寻找了数千本书，以及数万份文件……

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
... and met all kinds of people around the City, all to change the world.
也在都市各处遇见了各种各样的人。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
Change the world so that the oppressed can be free from the exploitative dominion of the ruling class and find liberation in the truest sense.
描绘着一个摆脱了统治阶级的剥削者，被压迫者们终于能得到真正解放的世界。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
And I want to make that world a reality.
为了创造那个世界。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content: However, I learned that such a world cannot be realized by changing what is already here. Once ink makes its mark on a page, it is permanent; you can't simply put the ink back in the pen. 但是，答案并不是“改变”。已经写错的那一页永远无法回头。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
Look closely. This is the world you and I can usher in.
好好看看吧。这就是你和我所能抵达的世界。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
A world… that can be created using the Golden Bough with which you resonated.
通过与你共鸣的金枝而创造的……那样的世界。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
May no soul on this earth suffer from starvation ever again.
地面上没有一个人会饿肚子。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
May every individual have the right to pursue their delights, both spiritual and intellectual.
任何人都有权利追求精神和知识上的快乐。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
… Join hands with me, and I’ll gift you that world.
……如果和我同行的话，我会把那个世界送给你。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
It would be as if everything that has happened... hasn't happened at all.
就好像从一开始就什么都没有发生一样。

Ah.
啊。

Who could ever understand such a feeling?
谁又能理解呢。

Even the briefest glimpse of that world felt so dreamlike.
虽然只有短短一瞬，体会到的那个世界也如梦境一般。

I wanted to etch that mesmerizing instant into my memory so I wouldn't forget it—not even for a second.
虽然只是昙花一现，我也丝毫不想忘记那个瞬间。

If this were a dream, let my sleeping self never wake and join the residents of the dreaming world.
若这是梦，我宁愿自己成为梦中之人，再不苏醒。

But, despite everything…
尽管如此……

Sorry, I’m still turning down your offer.
抱歉，尽管如此我还是拒绝。

How should I put this…
怎么说呢……

I don’t wanna bask in the warmth just yet. I feel like I oughta be shivering in this cold a bit longer.
我还不想暖和起来。要在这寒风中再多打颤一会儿才行啊。

Think I’ll stay this way, at least until I can answer whether I deserve to be warm again.
什么时候才会让自己暖和起来呢，我想，在找到那个答案前，自己还会待在这里。

Besides, Sonya…
还有，索尼亚……

You knew my temper would get the best of me and make me kill her, didn’t you?
那个时候，你从一开始就知道我忍不下去，会想去解决她吧？

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
Rodya, this will probably elude you, but you don’t have the Sign. 
罗佳，虽然你可能还很难理解，但你没有印记。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
I came here hoping to see you possess it, but I’m seeing it on a few of your friends instead.
虽然我来这里，就是希望看到你能拥有它，但我反而在你其他朋友们身上看到了。

The Sign? What do you…
印记？什么意……

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
On top of that, you can’t even see the Sign. In other words… you don’t have what it takes to lead.
而且你连印记都看不到。也就是说……你没有领导他人的能力。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
But I’m different. So, to make a better world—
但我不同。所以为了更好的世界……

Yeah, yeah. I think I remember hearing ya say something like that a while ago, sitting atop a desk buried in piles of books.
嗯。你在堆满书的桌子前也说过类似的话。

…That’s why I can’t join you.
……所以我和你不是一路人。

I still believe that your big words and endless debates won't ever feed the neighbors.
毕竟书桌前所说的空话，是无法填饱邻居们的肚子。

And as I’m sure you’ve learned by now…
何况你也明白的吧……

There’s no way a rowdy rascal like me would fit under some dweeb’s leadership, right? Hahah!
像我这样的混蛋又怎么会向别人低头呢？啊哈哈！

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
The Golden Bough awaits inside the castle, Rodya.
金枝就在那座城堡里，罗佳。

dataList.title:
Yurodivy
圣愚
dataList.content:
I hope you’ll be able to find what you seek.
愿你平安找到你想要的东西。

We walked past Sonya, and then made our way into the icy castle he indicated.
就这样，我们从索尼亚身边经过，走进了他所指的冰之城堡。
